runtime_change: Regression history reads decode the same latest 500 rows but retain only the winning snapshot per payload-hour. Ordering, cap behavior, all row decoding/quarantine, valid-row diagnostic counts and worker cadence are preserved. Public load_range/load_range_page still return the complete normal page through the same visitor. No persistent cache, dependency or timer is added.

runtime_native_comparison.scope: Real HistoryStore native fixture with 610 fixed synthetic rows, 64 entities per snapshot, normal latest-500 selection and eight read/downsampling phases per process. Four baseline and four candidate processes in ABBA/BAAB order; same executable, database table values including payload bytes and full JSON outputs verified. Native kernel largest-process peak RSS is separate from sampled tree RSS. Phase CPU is native CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID, including native threads; whole-fixture costs also include identical seeding/export/cleanup. No app-wide or general regression-worker attribution claim.
runtime_native_comparison.work: 610 rows, 64 entities and two components per snapshot, eight identical reads per native process; exactly two full snapshots returned in every phase.

recovery.oracle: Offline immutable read mode only after native process exit and absent/empty WAL; primary DB bytes verified before/after each audit.

runtime_native_comparison.memory: Native macOS getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) peak RSS in bytes, including fixture initialization/exports; mean across four processes per variant. Separate from the one-second sampled tree RSS. CPU phases use CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID over the read/downsample call, including native threads. No app physical-footprint percentage inferred.

contract_tests.cases: Full serialized output against old algorithm over ranges/caps including 0, 1, 4, 400 and usize::MAX; 610 rows/latest-500 cutoff, metadata ties and nonmonotonic payload times; JSON, legacy bincode and envelope formats. Separate stores verify corrupt/missing payload handling and all snapshot/quarantine values, excluding only actual quarantine wall-clock timestamp.

configuration.diagnostic_transformation: CARGO_BIN shim adds -vv --message-format=json and a per-package release codegen-units override for aetower-mcp. The same pinned Cargo, jobs=2, all normal batched runtime roots, host bindgen and binding publication are retained. Other compiler settings must remain unchanged.

compiler_candidate.scope: Partial-root rebuild of normal runtime pipeline, not cold dependency compilation, Swift, whole CI or app memory. Compiler partitioning hypothesis; no hard memory or CPU thread cap. Product code may differ across codegen variants, so ABI and runtime equivalence require separate checks. Sampled aggregate tree RSS, shared-host load uncontrolled.

effective_options_and_size_audit.scope: Actual ordered rustc -C options agree except intentional MCP partition count and artifact identity. Bytes on disk are not runtime footprint; shared-host partial-root rebuild only.

compiler_candidate.tradeoff: Eight adds 149968 library bytes (about 146 KiB, +1.29%) versus four in the matched pre-reader source comparison. It reduces mean total compiler CPU by 11.11% and elapsed time by 25.60%; shorter builds can use more instantaneous CPU. Mean sampled RSS is only about 3% lower with substantial variation, so no robust further memory saving or hard CPU/thread/memory cap is established. The setting affects only release MCP; other crates, optimization/LTO, stripping, panic behavior and job budgets are unchanged.

limitations: Native benchmark is fixed synthetic history data, not a whole-app measurement. Actual benefit depends on history payloads and distinct-hour count.
All 500 selected rows are still decoded; corruption quarantine and normal diagnostics are preserved rather than skipped for speed.
Pass19 app cohorts showed changing background activity; hidden state alone did not establish an equal workload. No causal attribution of that activity to the regression worker is established.
No installed app, release or merge changed. Hosted dependency-policy preflight remains failing; no passing hosted job or CI performance percentage claimed.
